prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Make one original portrait illustration of Jackie Leven for the 1978 chapter of a dark homage website, in the already established portrait series.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the original photographic identity reference, a Doll by Doll album cover with a strongly side-lit man. The photographed man is Jackie Leven. Use his real facial proportions, expression, age and swept-back dark hair. Discard ALL album lettering, borders, graphic rules, logos, colour casts and cover composition.
Image 2 is the approved Doll-by-Doll-era illustration from this same website. It is the reference for the dry-brush style, degree of abstraction, subdued grey palette and organic dark edges. Match this visual language, but derive the new pose, facial expression and directional lighting from photo 1.

SUBJECT AND MOOD:
The Jackie of photo 1 in his late twenties: clean-shaven, dark hair swept high back off a broad forehead, strong eyebrows, distinctive straight prominent nose, natural mouth, youthful but forceful facial anatomy. Alert, unsentimental, intense rock musician; lips very slightly parted as in the source, without exaggeration. Preserve the person's recognizable features and asymmetries, do not prettify, caricature or age him. No beard, glasses or accessories.
The defining feature of this variation is the dramatic SIDE LIGHT in the photo: one eye, a cheek and the ridge of the nose emerge from shadow, while the far side of the face almost merges with darkness. Interpret this through economical neutral-grey marks. Keep the shadow eye subtly readable rather than erased or distorted. The portrait should feel alive and self-possessed, not sinister or ghostly.

NEW COMPOSITION:
Vertical 4:5 head-and-upper-chest portrait with full crown visible, breathing room above and on both sides. Move the head closer to the centre compared with the record cover, slightly left of centre; shoulders turn gently toward the viewer's left while the face turns nearly frontal and the eyes meet the viewer. Modest natural counter-turn, no exaggerated head tilt. Retain the open shirt collar as a few rough dark-grey strokes and a small muted neck/chest plane. Garment is almost black with no recognizable button-by-button detail, fabric patterns or chest hairs. Hands outside frame. Upper chest and shoulder contours dissolve into loose dry-brush marks rather than a solid rectangular torso.
Create an independent portrait composition, not a literal redrawing of the album layout.

STYLE:
Same restrained, raw dry-brush ink drawing as image 2, with a few large matte grey pigment shapes, irregular broken brush edges and sparse directional hatching. Face likeness from precisely placed eye/nose/mouth shapes; simplified broad light and shadow planes rather than fine photographic modelling. Hair is grouped into loose sweeping dark masses and sparse grey gestures, not individual strands. Shirt mostly unworked darkness with a handful of expressive collar and shoulder strokes. Clearly an illustration at small webpage scale. Avoid polished digital painting, smooth airbrush gradients, photorealistic skin, over-detailed engraving, mechanical vector posterization, glossy paint or uniformly embossed texture.

COLOUR AND DARK BACKGROUND:
Match the website background #0d0f12. Neutral charcoal and muted grey ONLY, no brown, sepia, blue or warm colour cast, no red or yellow from the cover. Face highlights approximately #62696d to #787e81, very sparing accents up to #888d90, never white. Preserve the dramatic distribution of the side light but compress its brightness to the quiet tonal range of image 2: most of the canvas is dark or near-black. Eyes and nostrils remain naturally dark within lit grey planes; no negative-image inversion. A selectively drawn low-key portrait, not a dim transparent photograph.
All outer edges become plain anthracite with no visible border, halo, paper grain field or frame. No words, text, signatures, logos, cover graphics, instruments, props, scenery or other people. One standalone portrait.
status: user-favorite; preserve while exploring a more mysterious shadow variant
